title: Implement measured DOS AH=48h/AH=49h conventional-memory allocation lifecycle
description: WORK3-031 original-byte replay advances through INT 2Fh AX=1500 and 129 DPMI AX=0501 allocations, then stops at DOS INT 21h AH=48h at 0x001c3d21 with BX=1 paragraph. The Python DosHost has an MCB free-block model but no DOS AH=48/AH=49 dispatch. Implement paragraph allocation from the existing PSP-owned MCB chain, returning AX=segment on success or AX=8/BX=largest block/CF on insufficient memory; track only AH=48-owned blocks for AH=49 free and coalesce MCBs. Preserve DPMI AX=0100's selectors and the bounded DOS/4GW layout.
acceptance: Original-byte AH=48h request at 0x001c3d21, BX=1 is served from a PSP-owned free MCB with AX=returned data segment and CF clear
Insufficient memory reports AX=8, BX=largest available paragraph count, CF set; zero/invalid requests do not fabricate success
AH=49h frees only tracked AH=48h allocations, rejects invalid segments with AX=9/CF set, and coalesces adjacent MCBs
DPMI AX=0100 allocation/free/resize, PSP/environment ownership, and DOS resize behavior remain coherent
Original-byte -k replay passes AH=48h and records the next exact service or fault; no MENU claim without root evidence
